scope: Actual isolated PostgreSQL; simulated Discord guild/API only; zero external channel writes or Gateway connections

checks.name: permission preflight reports exact missing permissions before any Discord write
categories and six public channels reconcile by durable IDs without duplicate creation; boards readonly and general chat writable
private rooms deny every role, permit only exact owner/coordinator/own bot, and recheck live ACL before private sends
private job rooms bind immutable participant sets and retry without adopting unrelated named channels
uncertain channel create persists marker and refuses duplicate retry
generic registered agent rooms support owner-preserving verified-bot addition, with foreign owner and human-as-bot refused
uncertain bot-add outcome blocks private delivery until exact owner-preserving target ACL reconciles
